claim_steps: Go to krispykreme.com or download the Krispy Kreme app (free)
Create a free Rewards account and enter your birthday
On your birthday, your free dozen Original Glazed reward activates automatically
Visit any Krispy Kreme and show your app -- no purchase needed!

deals.title: Free doughnut when you join Krispy Kreme Rewards
deals.description: Join Krispy Kreme Rewards and get a free doughnut of your choice on your first visit. No purchase required.
claim_steps: Go to krispykreme.com or download the Krispy Kreme app
Create a free Rewards account (takes 2-3 minutes)
Your free doughnut reward will appear immediately
Visit any Krispy Kreme and show your account to redeem -- no purchase needed!
